purpose: Select a self-hosted coding model and harness worth piloting on repository issues under a mean charged-token allowance, and inspect the decision on issues withheld from selection.
question: coding-pilot

sources.title: Holistic Agent Leaderboard
sources.observation: Cost-aware agent benchmarking and a reusable harness existed a year before this study. The authors describe 21,730 rollouts across nine benchmarks.
sources.scope: HAL datasets and configurations. Different pricing and cache conventions can affect comparisons.

sources.title: An Empirical Study of Harness Design for Coding Agents
sources.observation: Four models were evaluated across 176 matched settings on SWE-bench Verified and Terminal-Bench 2.1.
sources.scope: Component-level changes inside a controlled harness. This demonstrates older feasibility of matched comparisons.

sources.title: Pairing Matters
sources.observation: The study applies a common grader and metering setup to six harnesses and three lightweight coding models on 100 shared issues.
sources.scope: One observed trial for each issue and pairing. The 100 issues and controlled configurations define the population actually observed.

sources.title: Pairing Matters research artifact, version 1
sources.observation: The Figshare version and DataCite's Issued date agree on October 22. The GitHub companion appeared October 23. Its task-level table includes failures and common token accounting.
sources.scope: Charged tokens include repeated and cached context at full weight. Unreported usage is not imputed. Energy, accelerator occupancy, verification labor, billed cash and live client transfer are unmeasured.

sources.title: Beyond Leaderboard Ranks
sources.observation: The authors study budget-constrained selection from 58,197 HAL run-task records and compare successive halving and other allocation policies.
sources.scope: A direct competitor on agent selection, with cost and statistical uncertainty. Its data and pricing are distinct from the registered self-hosted cohort.

sources.title: Progress on provable inference for large language models
sources.observation: The authors demonstrate proofs of committed inference for a large mixture-of-experts model. Their verifier has lower hardware requirements than the prover.
sources.scope: Upstream demonstration. A local hash, benchmark verdict or copy of the paper is insufficient to authenticate a particular response.

sources.title: Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v5
sources.observation: The index introduced an evaluation covering 70 scientific terminal workflows alongside other benchmark changes.
sources.scope: A suite for testing agents on defined tasks. Real experimental discoveries and applicability to a beneficiary's workflow require independent evidence.

public-run-matrix.reason: Complete matched rows with registered identity.

candidates.title: Adopt the highest observed resolution rate
candidates.value: Quickly nominate a starting point for a self-hosted pilot.
candidates.method: Read the authors' all-task summary table.
candidates.tradeoff: Training and audit issues are pooled; the mean resource ceiling is unchecked.
candidates.test: Compare the headline winner's audit issue scores and all-attempt tokens with the frozen allowance.

candidates.title: Adopt an established cost-aware evaluator
candidates.value: Reuse mature evaluation infrastructure for future local triage.
candidates.method: Use the HAL evaluator and its existing public records.
candidates.tradeoff: The public HAL cohort does not establish this exact 18-way grid. Cash and charged-token units differ.
candidates.test: Match the requested systems, tasks, grader and accounting definitions before transporting a result.
candidates.effort: Inspect task and configuration overlap before any new run.

candidates.title: Remeasure all systems on a private backlog
candidates.value: Measure fit to the actual institution, with its own grader.
candidates.method: Run a prospectively metered factorial trial on approved machines and issues.
candidates.tradeoff: Requires models, compute, data rights, independent grading and the cost of every attempted cell.
candidates.test: Obtain permission, freeze task selection and record a complete pilot block before expansion.
candidates.effort: One new model run per issue and selected configuration, plus independent grading.

candidates.title: Target the failure mode worth repairing
candidates.value: Find a targeted repair worth instrumenting on the next trial.
candidates.method: Use the authors' reviewed failure categories to formulate a falsifiable intervention.
candidates.tradeoff: Diagnosis does not measure repair efficacy or choose an affordable deployment configuration.
candidates.test: Freeze a repair, run fresh issues and compare with unchanged harness behavior.
candidates.effort: Review published categories first; a treatment effect needs new executions.

candidates.title: Acquire just enough trials to choose a system
candidates.value: Save evaluation effort when a full fresh matrix is expensive.
candidates.method: Use the HAL-based study's allocation baselines, including successive halving.
candidates.tradeoff: Prospective cost information and correctly priced, comparable trials matter. Its 48 shared SWE Mini issues differ from this cohort.
candidates.test: Check performance with and without advance cell costs on new governed trials.
candidates.effort: Reuse existing selection code or acquire additional samples under a registered budget.

challengers.title: Replay every pairing on the same withheld issues
challengers.value: Choose a configuration or pair under a resource allowance without buying another round of inference.
challengers.method: Partition issues once, choose on calibration rows, charge every recorded attempt, then evaluate the locked choice on audit issues.
challengers.tradeoff: Replay depends on the published grader and sample. A two-system portfolio requires an equivalent oracle to select a passing patch in practice.
challengers.test: Hold out issues, compare with an independent exhaustive SQL implementation and keep unfavourable outcomes.
challengers.effort: Read 1,800 licensed measurements and run a finite offline search. SQL can compute the same result.
